correctness.rationale: Exact shortest-path geometry proves the interval/parity-progressions classification, and explicit trace arguments and sums prove counts. An exhaustive finite decision-tree rank recurrence proves each asserted rank through order twenty, with a complete witness tree at order ten and a separately implemented Boolean rank-feasibility check through order twelve. Graph-distance convexity enumeration agrees through eleven. The all-order 2 log_2 n + O(1) law has independent constructive lower and counting upper mathematical bounds; no finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The first entropy ceiling failure at order ten is a motivated exact finite threshold for graph-geodesic online learning: the 76-hypothesis class has six bits of counting capacity yet online dimension exactly five. The full initial rank spectrum identifies further nonattainment windows, while the structural interval-plus-parity description and all-order logarithmic separation provide a natural interpretation and reproducible benchmark. Known static general-position deductions are not treated as the new value.
